archetypes.name: wait-contract
archetypes.rationale: The change is contract prose pinned by literal structural checks.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the Monitor ban and premature-notification recovery exception are stated consistently across AGENTS.md, /implement, and /design. Verify each new structural assertion pins a literal that appears verbatim in the edited surface and does not accidentally broaden the polling-loop allowance. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
